newsitem.title: USA: Frank Zarb is leading candidate to head NASD - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Frank Zarb is leading candidate to head NASD - WSJ.

text.p: Frank Zarb, former head of Travelers Group's Smith Barney Inc, is the leading candidate to succeed Joseph Hardiman as head of the National Association of Securities Dealers, The Wall Street Journal reported Tuesday, citing people familiar with the situation.

Though he has not been formally offered the job, the story said the 61-year-old Zarb is the leading prospect of the NASD search committee, which has been looking for a successor to Hardiman for months.
Hardiman will leave the post at the end of the month as part of an expected retirement plan, the story said.
The NASD is the self-regulatory group that runs the Nasdaq Stock Market.
Neither Hardiman nor the NASD would discuss prospective successors for the Journal story. Zarb is quoted as saying he's made no final decisions about his next move.
